text: When the path is blocked, do not rush to turn back. If you are banging your head against a wall, and already think that this is how the Universe (God) is showing you that this is not for you, before abandoning what you have started, calm down and turn to the Universe with a request to show a bypass route. After that, relax and give time for the answer to come. It happens that very nearby there is a door or an inconspicuous path that will lead you to the goal by a more beautiful and interesting way.
